title: My Alcoholic Friends
lyrics:
[00:02.18]I'm counting back
[00:05.32]The number of the steps
[00:07.52]It took for me to get
[00:09.77]Back on the wagon of the weekend
[00:13.22]I'll use the auto-timer to prove that I'll
[00:18.48]Get home with my imagination
[00:21.82]If they find the body in the basement
[00:26.22]"In the very house that she was raised in"
[00:30.54]I'm taking down
[00:33.64]The number of the Times
[00:35.77]So when we get the sign
[00:38.05]From God I'll be the first to call them
[00:41.53]I'm taking back the number of the beast
[00:46.67]'Cause six is not a pretty number
[00:50.12]Eight or three are definitely better
[00:54.48]A is for the address on the letter
[00:58.72]To my alcoholic friends
[01:11.83]I'm trying hard
[01:15.12]Not to be ashamed
[01:17.37]Not to know the name
[01:19.39]Of who is waking up beside me
[01:22.93]Or the date, the season or the city
[01:27.19]But at least the ceiling's very pretty
[01:31.42]And if you are holding it against me
[01:35.63]I'll be on my best behavior
[01:39.82]Taking shots for mother nature
[01:44.03]Once my fist is in the cupboard
[01:48.28]Love is never falling over
[01:57.63](Hey)
[02:04.17](One, two, three, four)
[02:06.22]Should I choose a noble occupation?
[02:10.57]If I did I'd only show up late and sick
[02:15.67]And they would stare at me with hatred
[02:19.07]Plus my only natural talent's wasted on my alcoholic friends
[02:28.21]My alcoholic friends
[02:32.32]The party never ends
[02:36.63]My alcoholic friends
